Definition: adverb from the same as G3897; in a manner near by, i.e. (figuratively) similarly:--likewise.
BiblicalUsage: Paraplesios means in a like manner, similarly. It appears once, in Hebrews 2:14, where the children are partakers of flesh and blood, and Christ Himself likewise took part of the same, so that through death He might destroy the devil.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe He took flesh the same way we have it, so that His death would count for us, and that likeness is the heart of the gospel.
